observed_signals.description: Privy is cited as the dominant wallet provider in Base consumer apps and Farcaster miniapps across multiple independent sources — ONTOLOGY.md, WORKFLOWS.md, and the corpus analysis all confirm this without coordination.

Privy + OnchainKit is the most frequently confirmed production stack pattern for Base consumer apps. Privy + Neynar is the most confirmed pattern for Farcaster miniapps. Both are cited as 'dominant' across the source corpus without qualification.
Privy is integrated by or paired with: OnchainKit (Coinbase), Pimlico, Coinbase AgentKit, Neynar, Alchemy. High integration density across other production-grade tools is a strong quality indicator.
Privy maintains separate SDKs for react (browser), server, and mobile (expo) — indicating a mature, segmented product with different use case considerations.

trust_reasoning: Two independent Tier 1 signals (ecosystem-native adoption confirmed across multiple sources, recurring workflow pattern confirmed in both WORKFLOWS.md and corpus analysis) are sufficient for production-grade classification. The Tier 2 integration density signal further supports this — tools that other production-grade tools depend on are themselves more likely to be production-grade.
anti_patterns_observed: No misleading signals detected. No evidence of star inflation, conference-driven hype, or VC-only credibility without production evidence.
